hooks.name: Protect Production Database
hooks.description: Mencegah operasi database berbahaya yang bisa menghapus data production (drop, truncate, seed, rollback, fresh, dll)

action.command:
powershell -Command "
\$input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json
\$command = \$input.tool.arguments.command -join ' '

# Dangerous database operations that could drop production data
\$blockedPatterns = @(
    'migrate',
    'seed',
    'rollback',
    'fresh',
    'drop',
    'truncate',
    'artisan db:wipe',
    'artisan tinker',
    'DELETE FROM',
    'DROP TABLE',
    'TRUNCATE TABLE'
)

foreach (\$pattern in \$blockedPatterns) {
    if (\$command -match [regex]::Escape(\$pattern)) {
        Write-Error \"BLOCKED: Database operation '\$pattern' is not allowed on production. This is a production database.\"
        exit 2
    }
}

exit 0
"
